note: Upson County GA (13293). The only county-published parcel service found, the Upson County Georgia Parcels Feature Service on services9.arcgis.com (Parcel_Regions_w_WinGAP), returns 'Token Required' at the service root and at layer /0, so it is not publicly queryable. The qPublic viewer (Schneider, AppID 562) returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge (HTTP 403) and exposes no REST endpoint. Equator Studios offers SHP/GPKG only through a sign-up flow; Dynamo Spatial is a paid shapefile listing. Two generic Parcels services on services1 and services7 were checked at the county point (-84.29286, 32.84484) and return no features, so they are not Upson. Upson County IT page lists no GIS links.
